method: Existing V10 and current V11 receipts on the same Windows host. Same deterministic graph fixtures, gesture harness and 4K fixture. No whole-session FPS or OS input latency claim.

v10-minimal-no-image.metric_semantics: Paint timings are actual WebEngine Canvas draw durations. All paint intervals, when exposed by the renderer, retain idle/IPC gaps; active intervals additionally exclude gaps >=100 ms. Neither is whole-session FPS. Event-to-paint begins at JS pointer handler. IPC pauses are excluded from that latency.
